title: THE WARDEN OF SEVEN STREETS
author: CLAUDE

rounds.summary: The slate's strongest dramatic test of the R14 core: Dov is a dangerous superhuman protector whose factual premise is right, the threatened residents cannot safely be treated as scenery, and simply defeating him would restore the very harm he is preventing. His goal and objection are concrete, while Illuminara's listening walk and the residents' evidence change the intervention from force to accountable protection. The union, maintenance-contract proof and elected stewardship can produce a visible positive result without erasing the dead or granting instant redemption. It is placed first because the six-day assault clock, limited district and central exchange make the frontier highly legible and finishable early.

First draft of S1 from C04, following B01. B01 biggest risk handled: the union and contract trail does not arrive from nowhere. The residents expose it themselves (Perpetua's biscuit tin of carbon work orders, kept from nineteen years as a maintenance dispatcher; Nell's missing stairwell door in scene 2 plants the removed fire doors), Dov presses his question twice (scene 1 and scene 4, who stops them when he is at the wrong end of the district), and the stand-down depends on protection already operating: the union is registered with seven signatures (scene 5), Inspector Hale posts a pumper under a fire-safety notice and opens a file, warrants are served on three named enforcers before Dov leaves the wall, and in scene 6 the stairwell watch stops Pell's man at Number 9 without Dov while Dov himself lays the slabs flat to let the pumper in. Illuminara's decisive contributions: asking permission at every corner and walking without an agenda, carrying the residents' unsaid words to Dov with their leave, recognising the carbons and the standing rule as the same errand, refusing to ask Dov to stand down before a replacement stood where the wall stood, and taking the weight of a burning landing so the Dray family could descend. Power only holds a slab; it does not decide the conflict. Ruiz's objection (a wall is a wall; the next one will not be a rescue diver) is allowed to stand and is not answered with a speech. Costs kept: two stairwell deaths (Hanne Ostrov, Marcus Bell) are not undone, Dov is charged for the paving and censured, Strand's company will resurface under a new name. Outcome (3a): assault called off, three enforcers charged, repair orders on every stairwell, a registered union with Dov as first steward, the district stays. To check: speaker count and scene 6...

An unusually assured first draft that already solves the selection forecast in scenes rather than explanation. The dusk walk, Perpetua's biscuit tin, Dov's roof confession and the Number 9 fire form a strong causal sequence; Dov is dangerous without becoming a strawman, the residents remain named agents, and the dead are not redeemed away. The dialogue has texture and wit, and the ending's argument about chairs is both hopeful and earned in tone. Three load-bearing joints still need revision before final: the emergency access proof currently depends on Dov and gives him a power the source did not establish, the residents' mandate and Dov's voluntary loss of unilateral authority happen mostly offstage, and the criminal/inspection chain outruns the evidence and the stated seventy-two-hour process.

Revision answering all three GPT priority points as ACCEPTED. The non-priority notes were also taken: Perpetua's 'Evening, Warden' is now a speaker-labelled turn; no eighth speaker was added (Cole Rudd and Lund are named only in narration or one line); the Number 9 suspect is Cole Rudd, Pell is arrested in scene 7. Time scale corrected: the founding meeting is three days before the assault, the fire two nights before, Dov's days at the gate counted consistently (19, 22, 25). Protected as asked: the asking at every corner, the biscuit tin, Dov's fear, Ruiz's objection, the watch with radios, extinguishers, pumper and bicycle lock, Illuminara bearing only the burning landing, Dov's quiet 'One thing.', the closing argument about chairs. The revision is longer than T01 (about 3,200 words by a rough count of spoken and narrated text); if the critic wants the length cut before final, the first candidates are the scene 7 opening paragraph and scene 5 terms.

STRONG REVISION WITH THREE BOUNDED FINAL-PASS REPAIRS. T03 materially answers all three T02 priorities: the residents vote and clear a permanent fire lane before the emergency, Dov accepts one vote and no gate under removable steward authority, and the Number 9 fire proves the watch and pumper work while he is six hundred metres away. Hale now separates visible-hazard powers from the slower evidence chain, and Rudd/Pell are distinct. The story's emotional and political resolution is earned. The remaining concerns are a procedural contradiction in Hale's entry, an over-dense report paragraph with an unclear late corporate reference, and one arithmetic inconsistency in Dov's days at the gate.

AUTHOR_FINAL answering all three GPT T04 priority points as ACCEPTED, with three bounded edits only: (1) Hale's entry basis in scene 5, (2) the scene 7 opening paragraph reduced to one evidence chain with the Strand/Lund/Pike references removed, (3) Teodor's 'twenty-two days'. No other prose changed. Protected as asked: Illuminara asking at each corner, Perpetua's tin, Dov's fear and freely chosen one-vote/no-gate yes, the voted fire lane, Teodor's radio call and the watch, Ruiz's 'a wall is a wall', the nurse's moved bag, Nell's seven circles and the argument about chairs. Outcome: the nurse returns, Number 9 is saved by the watch without Dov, visible hazards are ordered fixed, warrants are served, the tactical assault is cancelled for a stated reason, and Dov becomes a removable steward; Hanne and Marcus are not erased.

T05 is the exact source-bound AUTHOR_FINAL and answers all three T04 priorities without reopening protected strengths. First, Hale enters under her own fire-inspection warrant and explicitly separates immediate visible-hazard authority from the later criminal file, so neither access nor standing rests on Dov's permission. Second, the final-scene opening now presents one readable evidence chain: eleven carbons match eleven invoices and the G. Pell payroll signature; Rudd is held; warrants are served with street stewards; Pell and the dispatcher are taken; doors are fitted or ordered and the contract is frozen. The late Strand, Lund and Pike references are gone. Third, the duration sequence is internally consistent: Dov has stood nineteen days at the opening, Teodor and Dov both name twenty-two days at the founding meeting, and the assault morning and closing image name twenty-five days. No further prose round is required.

final_critic_line: Illuminara does not break Dov Kessarin's wall; she listens until the seven streets can replace it with a voted fire lane, a shared watch and a removable steward, and Dov freely chooses to sit among the people he protected.

evaluation.note: Two genuine separate, source-bound READER_APPEAL_R1 judgments made after the 20:30 cutoff on a late BD decision: GPT in a fresh ChatGPT Temporary Chat, Claude in a fresh sandboxed one-shot call. Each reader saw only the story; both answers were sealed unread and opened only by script. Exact 50/50 arithmetic mean.
